files.title: Tongji Dream Classroom — Students and Volunteers
files.description:
Huocheng, Ili, Xinjiang, China.
Volunteer participation in the Tongji Dream Classroom project at Huocheng County Middle School. These photographs document the completed classroom and activities with students.

files.title: Classroom — Color and Shared Space
files.description:
Huocheng, Ili, Xinjiang, China.
A mountain mural and a continuous, undulating bookcase give the classroom a shared visual identity. Modular tables occupy the center of the room.

files.title: Classroom — A Place by the Window
files.description:
Huocheng, Ili, Xinjiang, China.
